purpose: Define bounded end-to-end Character Appearance workflows over all 25 governed Species profiles, including Character Builder entry/reopen, Species/Form/live biology, authored appearance, wardrobe/equipment projection, deterministic presets/randomization, fixed-view rendering, portrait/token handoff, permissions/accessibility and recovery without transferring upstream authority.

handoffs.name: character_builder_entry_return
handoffs.rule: Character Builder supplies Character/rules/species/equipment context; Appearance Studio returns appearance references without rewriting builder-owned mechanics.

handoffs.name: species_lineage_morphology_current_form
handoffs.rule: Species, lineage, morphology, current Form and transition eligibility are upstream authority; PPIA-06 only consumes authorized projections.

handoffs.name: persistent_active_biology
handoffs.rule: Persistent acquired markers and live biological state are read-only projections; hidden biology is filtered before derivation.

handoffs.name: actual_equipment_projection
handoffs.rule: Actual ownership/equipped/install state remains upstream; appearance receives compatible visual projections only.

handoffs.name: renderer_adapter
handoffs.rule: Renderer translates semantic state into assets/views; support gaps never become Character invalidity or biology.

handoffs.name: portrait_token_consumers
handoffs.rule: Downstream surfaces consume versioned presentation derivatives and never become semantic appearance authority.

handoffs.name: permissions_visibility_export
handoffs.rule: Minimum authorized projection filters hidden/restricted facts before derivatives, export and AI context.

handoffs.name: persistence_operation_recovery
handoffs.rule: P06-MUT-001 receipts, appearance_state_version and operation_id govern safe writes/reopen/recovery.

handoffs.name: ai_advisory_context
handoffs.rule: AI may summarize/propose only from authorized semantic projection and cannot commit or infer hidden/source-owned biology.

workflow_group_resolution: Projection-group coverage is derived deterministically from each listed governed action's groups in PPIA-06_APPEARANCE_INSPECTOR_ACTION_CONTRACT_MATRIX_v0.1.0.json; workflows do not duplicate group lists.

workflows.name: character_builder_entry_author_save_reopen
workflows.result: Character Builder handoff, bounded authoring, save and reopen preserve semantic appearance without mechanics transfer.

workflows.name: lineage_variant_and_species_boundary_rebase
workflows.result: Species/lineage changes rebase compatible appearance explicitly; unknown/incompatible fields never silently default.

workflows.name: unusual_topology_author_and_render
workflows.result: Unusual topology survives authoring, rendering and reopen with explicit renderer support diagnostics.

workflows.name: arborae_four_season_profiles
workflows.result: Four Arborae seasonal profiles persist independently while current season remains upstream.

workflows.name: mythragara_base_animal_derived_hybrid
workflows.result: Mythragara hybrid remains derived from authored parent profiles and current Form authority stays upstream.

workflows.name: nekron_one_time_transition_customization
workflows.result: Nekron transition is upstream one-time state; second customization derives from original appearance only after transition.

workflows.name: suula_persistent_and_active_biology
workflows.result: Suula history/live biology remain source-owned while nearby cosmetics and nonvisual parity remain editable.

workflows.name: furashin_live_phenotype_and_ratman_art_separation
workflows.result: All Arthold rat-humanoid art binds to Furashin under OVC-027 while the separate Ratman Species remains distinct; Furashin phenotype behavior remains source-bounded.

workflows.name: manytoms_composite_identity_preset_and_views
workflows.result: ManyToms persists one constituent identity plus cohesive collective presentation without hardcoded visible count.

workflows.name: stygian_conditional_wings_and_equipment_fit
workflows.result: Stygian wing presence/function remains upstream; equipment conflicts cannot mutate biology.

workflows.name: free_android_toba_augmentation_boundary
workflows.result: Free/Toba mechanical presentation separates authored cosmetics from actual installed augmentation authority.

workflows.name: presentation_wardrobe_vs_actual_equipment
workflows.result: Presentation wardrobe is visual-only and actual equipment preview is read-only with compatible variant fallback.

workflows.name: deterministic_randomization_presets_import_export
workflows.result: Randomization/preset/import is deterministic, lock-aware, source-safe and explicit about compatibility.

workflows.name: renderer_views_portrait_token_handoff
workflows.result: Fixed full-body/portrait/token derivatives hand off versioned presentation without pseudo-3D or semantic drift.

workflows.name: permission_accessibility_mobile_keyboard_nonvisual
workflows.result: Hidden-state filtering and mobile/keyboard/nonvisual parity hold across the complete Species surface.

workflows.name: versioned_write_ambiguous_result_recovery_and_reopen
workflows.result: All writes remain versioned/idempotent; stale or ambiguous outcomes recover before retry and reopen converges on one committed state.
